note: Signed, property-resolved context-value curves attack a monotonicity assumption baked into a decade of architecture design; the retrained-variant arm answers the off-manifold objection. A week of compute, decade of consequences. Lit-attacked below.

The Transfusion line already showed transfer often adds little for medical imaging; the 3D-dense, compute-matched, modality-distance-predictive version is a real refinement but arrives into a crowded conversation.

'Feed it everything is quantifiably wrong' with an aliasing attribution is cheap and practically valuable; multi-scale inference folklore partially covers it, so the predictable-crossover law is the scientific content.

The strong frame-independent baseline the VOS literature skips, over foundation-era features; the gap decomposition (what temporal machinery is actually FOR) is the deliverable. High embarrassment potential, honestly designed with tuned+naive variants.

Rerunning the boundary-loss literature under noise-floor-aware evaluation is the enforcement arm of the C07 metrology agenda; survival tabulation with CIs is the right format and released-code reproduction keeps it fair.

Direct gradient-flow instrumentation of Dice's per-instance starvation, with a data-side fix validating the mechanism, is instrument-level science on a loss the entire medical field uses; 2D-first scoping keeps it tractable. Top-5 in batch A.

Surgical fine-tuning (ICLR 2023) established that different shift types are best handled by tuning different layer blocks, including the photometric-early/semantic-mid structure; the dense-prediction port is an application note.

Saliency-faithfulness critiques are a mature classification genre; the segmentation-specific audit (cross-attention decoders vs per-pixel heads) is the open slice and would discipline a lot of qualitative-figure storytelling.
Shape-only semantic leakage with a privacy demonstration (scene/activity recovery from 'anonymized' masks) lands in both science and policy; cheap, decisive, and nobody has quantified it at scale.

The lazy/hard boundary-error split via model-free refinement is a beautiful cheap decomposition; CRF-era wisdom makes it revisit-not-discovery, and it shares its destiny with 0278 (decoders under-use available sharpness) - run them together.

Expertise-assistance interactions are documented in clinical AI-assistance studies (novices gain more); the segmentation-workflow-specific anchoring measurement is the delta, and expert recruitment is the bottleneck. Overlaps 0188's automation-bias program.

Metric-validity against instrumented consumers (grasping, measurement, navigation) is the study that decides whether benchmark rankings mean anything downstream; the small real-robot leg (own note) buys the credibility simulation lacks.
The unification tax with gradient-conflict localization is competent multi-task analysis; panoptic unification is no longer the field's center of gravity, which caps the impact.

'3D's difficulty reputation is an accounting artifact' - per-supervision-bit renormalization with the sparse-3D-beats-dense-2D corollary is a field-belief inversion with immediate annotation-budget consequences; fair bit-accounting (own note) is the entire fight. Protect.

Itemizing TTA's hidden bill (boundary blur, calibration distortion) with a property-selective variant is useful, cheap accounting; the effect may shrink under well-aligned TTA implementations, as it honestly notes.

The sign-splitting scale-ambiguity interaction (scale changes the CHARACTER of instability, not its amount) is the most sophisticated claim in the prompt-sensitivity family; needs the controlled mini-SAM series to be clean. Protect.

The two-regime arbiter profile (models beat individual annotators on measurement disputes, lose on knowledge disputes) is a genuinely useful consensus-protocol input; verification-anchored dispute sets are rare and their sampling bias is acknowledged.

The bag-of-words diagnosis is established for VLM retrieval (ARO-style scrambling tests); porting permutation-controlled evaluation to grounded SEGMENTATION with ordinals/relations/part-chains is the right next domino and likely to land hard.

Task-relativity of realism budgets is the right generalization of 0227/0094, but the three-task factorial render+train grid is among the most expensive designs in the batch; run it only if the single-task versions pay out.

'An emergent capability being actively trained away by modal supervision' is a striking, measurable thesis connecting amodal completion to tracking robustness; synthetic-composite scale plus real validation subsets is the right data strategy.

The augmentation tax on exactly the hard classes this catalog cares about (transparency, camouflage, thin structures) is a unifying explanation candidate for several clusters' failures; factorial attribution across augmentation families is the standard fight.

Robust-fine-tuning frontier work (LP-FT, WiSE-FT era) covers the concept for classification; the dense-task frontier with a tuning-data-diversity predictor is a usable refinement rather than a discovery.

The inference-vs-training compute exchange rate for segmentation, stratified by input difficulty, imports the test-time-compute question into dense vision before the wave arrives; the label-free selection signal is the acknowledged prerequisite.

'Part of boundary error is an unresolved disagreement about what boundaries MEAN' (functional vs photometric) reframes evaluation itself; the signed per-junction-type offset is measurable and the affordance grounding disciplines the taxonomy. Among the deepest ideas in the batch.

The deletion-similarity law ('classes visually similar to target negatives die first') and the dormancy-vs-deletion test are the fresh parts of an otherwise-known forgetting story; cheap rehearsal fix makes it practical.

Multi-modal (not noisy-binary) disagreement structure invalidating pairwise-agreement certification is foundational annotation theory; a 10-rater panel on 300 items is expensive but small compared to the claim's reach. Protect.

'When is the mask an unnecessary middleman' deflates segmentation's assumed universality with a matched-budget three-task test and an auditability-aware decision rule; the honest framing of regression's auditability loss preempts the obvious rebuttal.
